issues.on_page: Community development 8,128.64 (General Fund 5,128.64 = Community Center department p10; Keno Fund 3,000.00)
issues.issue: The printed label is 'Community development', not 'Community development/betterment'. The General Fund part is the Community Center department (supplies, services, utilities). Community Betterment is supported by the General Fund's restricted 'Community Betterment' fund balance and the keno funding. Economic development or culture/recreation are also defensible. This is a judgment call; the same applies to detail[50]-[53] and detail[78].
